{{Top}}
{{Conflicting|''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''|''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''}}
[[File:RystalSant2-SWM80.png|thumb|right|[[Rystáll Sant/Legends|Rystáll Sant]], a [[Theelin/Legends|Theelin]]/[[Human/Legends|Human]] hybrid]]
A '''hybrid''' was an individual with [[Parent/Legends|parentage]] from more than one [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]].

==Biology==
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] species was able to interbreed with the [[Coynite/Legends|Coynite]],<ref name="Uhl Eharl Khoehng short story">{{JournalCite|8|Uhl Eharl Khoehng (short story)}}</ref> [[Echani/Legends|Echani]],<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref> [[Ferroan]],<ref name="Rogue Planet">''[[Rogue Planet]]''</ref> [[Hamadryas]],<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> [[Kiffar/Legends|Kiffar]],<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines">''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''</ref> [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]],<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic Handbook]]''</ref> [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]],<ref name="The Forgotten War: The Nagai and the Tofs">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/nagai11202009/index.html|text=The Forgotten War: The Nagai and the Tofs|int=The Forgotten War: The Nagai and the Tofs}}</ref> [[Theelin/Legends|Theelin]],<ref name="The Essential Guide to Characters">''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]],<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> and a number of other species. When Humans bred with the [[Kalai]], the resulting offspring were known as [[Lethagoe]]<ref name="Zirtran's Anchor article">{{JournalCite|5|Zirtran's Anchor (article)}}</ref> and with the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] the [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirians]].<ref name="Everything You Always Wanted to Know about the Nightsisters but Were Afraid to Ask">{{InsiderCite|122|Everything You Always Wanted to Know about the Nightsisters but Were Afraid to Ask}}</ref>

On the other hand, Humans were unable to interbreed with the [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]], [[Qiraash/Legends|Qiraash]], [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]], or [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]] species.<ref name="Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref> Humans were also incompatible with the [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]],<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Omen">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]'', Chapter Five</ref> and [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]]<ref name="Republic 59">[[Republic 59|''Republic'' 59]]</ref> species.

Other compatible hybrid combinations included [[Borneck]] with [[Etti]],<ref name="Who's Who: Imperial Grand Admirals">{{InsiderCite|66|Who's Who: Imperial Grand Admirals}}</ref> and [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] with [[Sephi/Legends|Sephi]].<ref name="KOTOR48">[[Knights of the Old Republic 48|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 48]]</ref> There was a [[half-Bothan]] population<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Farfalla system/Legends|Farfalla]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Other incompatible combinations included [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] with [[H'nemthe (species)/Legends|H'nemthe]],<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> and [[Zelosian]] with [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] and other [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]].<ref name="Death Star novel">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref> [[Moggonite/Legends|Moggonite]] were capable of interbreeding with at least one species.<ref name="Companion">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref>

The [[Exiles]] used [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]]<ref name="END">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/88/indexp2.html|text=''Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties''|int=Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties}}</ref> to interbreed with the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] species.<ref name="Golden2">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 2]]</ref>

Many species ostracized members who bore hybrid children.<ref name="Nightlily: The Lovers' Tale">{{StoryCite|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina|story=Nightlily: The Lovers' Tale}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
According to ''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''<ref name="Order 66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref> and ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]'',<ref name="501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref> and also the [[Star Wars: X-Wing (novel series)|''X-Wing'']] series of books by [[Michael A. Stackpole]] and [[Aaron Allston]], [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]] were genetically incompatible. However, ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]'' directly contradicts this, indicating that such pairings could indeed produce hybrid offspring. As it is the most recent source, this article follows the ''Character Encyclopedia''.
